description: Lists the pages of turva.dev, read from the site's /llms.txt when you call it: the main pages, the sample report, the guides and the blog posts, grouped under the index's sections, each with a title and a path that get_page accepts as it stands. Use this when you do not know which pages exist or which path a page has, then call get_page with the path. For the services and prices use get_services, and for who runs turva.dev use get_contact. Each call sends one GET request to turva.dev through a service binding that reaches no other host and forwards nothing from your request. It lists only turva.dev's own pages, each once, and it does not follow a redirect. A tool error comes back when the site answers with a status other than 2xx or with more than 262144 bytes, or when the index lists no pages.
name: get_page_index

count.description: The number of pages listed in sections, which is the sum of the page counts of all sections.

sections.description: The sections of the index in its order. A section with no listed page is left out.

pages.description: The pages of the section, in the order of the index.

path.description: The path of the page on turva.dev. Pass it to get_page as it stands. It ends in .md for a page and is served as text/markdown.

title.description: The title of the page as the index words it, at most 200 characters.
The heading of the section in the index, such as Services, Guides or Blog. Links that come before the first heading are listed under Index.

skipped_links.description: The number of links in the index that are not listed: a link to another host, a link whose path get_page would refuse, a link with a query string or a fragment, a page the index links twice after its first section, and every link past the limit of 500 pages.

source.description: The path of the index that was read, always /llms.txt.

title: Index of the pages of turva.dev
